notes: §2002:12.3.4.12.3 GR4: data-name-1 need be described in only one record description entry; the identical byte positions in any other entry of the file are implicitly keys. pb354's FD IXF has IX-REC (RECORD KEY IS IX-KEY, bytes 1-6) and IX-VIEW (VW-KEY, the same bytes). 'MOVE "BBBBBB" TO VW-KEY / START IXF KEY IS = VW-KEY' prints K2-OK and the READ NEXT K2=REC-03, the record whose prime key is BBBBBB: VW-KEY acts as the prime key. pb354_start_generic_key_ok run at --std 2002 on the pinned build: PASS.
